review_notes: I read the whole file. A grep of the pinned Mathlib for "quantile" and "Quantile" returned no files, so Mathlib has no competing quantile concept. `MeasureTheory.cdf` here is a thin wrapper. It is defined from `ProbabilityTheory.cdf (μ.map Subtype.val)` and lands in `I`. It reuses Mathlib's cdf and does not add a parallel API. The private `unitIntervalRat` set and its `Countable` instance support the countable-infimum argument in `measurable_quantile`. I did not find a matching Mathlib declaration for it. The other cdf and quantile definitions in the lean-pool repo (`cdfToUnitInterval`, `FD1D` `quantile`) work on ℝ or dyadic masses. They are different representations and not clear duplicates. I did not make a finding because the case for consolidating anything is unclear.
